thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SmartRouting alert: rapid health-check flapping detected across regions; routes bouncing us-east <-> us-west <-> eu (~40s oscillation). Affected pool: production-models-prod.*. Probe failure spike + request reroute churn. Initial detection at 1965432100.

Maya: seeing the same on dashboards, p50 latency doubled for several customers, error-rate up ~3%. Paging SRE oncall. @Ajay can you take? :eyes:

Ajay: on it. immediately pausing cross-region fallback policy for the impacted policy set. Running temporary mitigation.

Ajay: command I'm running:
```bash
# disable cross-region fallback until we stabilize
curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/routing/policies/prod/fallback -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"enabled":false,"reason":"flapping-mitigation-1965432100"}'
```

Remy: quick note — logs show probe TTLs expiring early and inconsistent probe responses from the health-proxy sidecar in eu and us-west. Example from probe logs (truncated):
```
[1965432098] health-proxy us-west -> us-east: probe=GET /_health 200ms -> 502 (read timeout)
[1965432102] health-proxy eu -> us-west: probe=GET /_health 190ms -> 503 (connection reset)
[1965432130] health-proxy us-east -> eu: probe=GET /_health 210ms -> 200
```
Remy: suggests a flaky probe client or transient packet loss between zones, TTL misconfig or overloaded probe threadpool.

Dana: adding infra context — we pushed a probe config change yesterday that reduced probe timeout from 500ms -> 250ms to reduce noise. That makes sense: network jitter now triggers false negatives. Reverting to 500ms should reduce flap.

Maya: agree. Two concurrent actions: (1) Ajay paused fallback routing to stop oscillation, (2) Dana please rollback probe timeout to 500ms. Also add a short cooldown on policy evaluation (increase policy re-eval window from 20s -> 90s).

Dana: rolling probe timeout revert to 500ms now across us-west and eu. ETA ~45s.

Ajay: I've also set a conservative cooldown on the SmartRouting policy engine:
```json
{"policy_eval_window_seconds":90,"fallback_enabled":false}
```
Applied to prod policy set.

Zach: customer-impact check: which customers hit errors? We have 8 high-usage customers with intermittent 502s; two reported a visible error page. Notifying CS for outreach.

Lucy: I'll draft a short status for the status page and notify the two affected customers. No legal/regulatory customers impacted as far as we can tell.

Remy: after disabling fallback and reverting probe timeout, the health checks look stable on the graph. probe_failure_rate{region_pair="us-west->us-east"} dropped from 0.78 -> 0.03 over ~2m.

Maya: good. we'll keep fallback disabled until we confirm stability for 15m across all regions and run a dry-run with longer timeouts.

Ajay: handover: I'm taking on-call ownership for mitigation and the immediate rollback. Maya standing by for postmortem.

Maya: handing page to Ajay. Paging note: escalate to Dana if rollback fails or if probe_failure_rate doesn't drop below 0.05 in 10m.

Ajay: acknowledged. also snapshotting routing policy and model-variant bindings in case we need to revert further.

Ajay: snapshot command output:
```text
snapshot_id=rs-20240310-1965432145
policies_changed=[prod.fallback:false, prod.policy_eval_window:90]
```

Remy: monitoring tail of logs shows a few residual 502s but no flip-flop. Running a focused packet capture between eu<->us-west to confirm no networking blips.

Dana: infrastructure rollback completed across eu & us-west. Confirmed probe-client threadpool at expected capacity.

Lucy: status page update posted: "Degraded — routing flapping mitigated, mitigation in progress, customers may experience intermittent errors. Engineering investigating." (link: https://status.redwood.example/incident/1965432100)

Zach: CS notified affected customers (IDs redacted): cust-17, cust-22. They were given ETA 30m and option for failover to dedicated.

Remy: packet capture looks clean for last 3m, so likely the reduced timeout was the primary trigger. Leaving analysis task for postmortem to see why packets momentarily delayed.

Ajay: preparing a rollback plan to re-enable fallback with safer parameters: longer eval window and a jittered cooldown. Plan: re-enable fallback in canary (10% traffic) for 30m once stable metrics confirmed.

Maya: epic/next steps:
- short postmortem draft (Ajay + Remy)
- config change review to prevent risky probe timeout PRs (Dana)
- add automated policy gating for cross-region fallback toggles (Remy)
- customer outreach summary (Lucy + Zach)

Ajay: taking notes and will own the postmortem draft. will include timeline, commands, snapshots, and proposed guardrails.

Maya: thanks team. leaving the channel but will check in at +30m. Ajay, ping me if anything regresses. :white_check_mark:

Ajay: will do. marking incident as "mitigated — manual policy pause + probe timeout rollback" for now. Follow-up meeting scheduled in #eng-postmortems at 1975435700.

Lucy: filing incident ticket and customer summary.

incident-bot: Incident update recorded. Severity: S2. Incident ID: INC-2026-1965432100.

Ajay: handing off monitoring to Remy for the next 15m while I finalize the postmortem notes.

Remy: monitoring. all looks stable as of 1965432285.

Maya: (reacted :thumbsup:)
